canal.label: Nonmetastatic anal canal squamous cell carcinoma: definitive concurrent chemoradiation pathway.

recommendation.title: Nonmetastatic anal canal squamous cell carcinoma: definitive concurrent chemoradiation pathway.

options.label: Definitive chemoradiation
options.text: Use fluoropyrimidine/mitomycin-based concurrent treatment per source; RT technique/dose per ANAL-C.

perianal.label: Perianal squamous cell carcinoma: stage/size-directed local excision or chemoradiation pathway.

recommendation.title: Perianal squamous cell carcinoma: stage/size-directed local excision or chemoradiation pathway.

options.label: Local excision
options.text: For source-defined small, well-differentiated, margin-clear lesions.

options.label: Chemoradiation
options.text: For lesions not meeting local-excision criteria or with adverse features.

surv.label: Complete response after definitive therapy: surveillance.

recommendation.title: Complete response after definitive therapy: surveillance.

options.label: Surveillance
options.text: Clinical exam and indicated imaging per source schedule.

salvage.label: Persistent/progressive local anal SCC after chemoradiation: biopsy/re-staging and salvage surgery pathway when feasible.

recommendation.title: Persistent/progressive local anal SCC after chemoradiation: biopsy/re-staging and salvage surgery pathway when feasible.

options.label: Salvage APR
options.text: Use when persistent/progressive localized disease is confirmed and operable.

recurrence.label: Anal SCC recurrence: site-specific salvage using surgery, RT/re-irradiation, and/or systemic therapy based on prior treatment and extent.

recommendation.title: Anal SCC recurrence: site-specific salvage using surgery, RT/re-irradiation, and/or systemic therapy based on prior treatment and extent.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use metastatic/subsequent options when disease is not locally salvageable.

met.label: Metastatic anal SCC: systemic therapy with source-preferred first-line regimen and subsequent immunotherapy/chemotherapy options.

recommendation.title: Metastatic anal SCC: systemic therapy with source-preferred first-line regimen and subsequent immunotherapy/chemotherapy options.

options.label: Subsequent therapy
options.text: Use biomarker/prior-exposure appropriate options from ANAL-B.

different.label: Non-squamous anal malignancy requires a different histology-specific pathway.

outside.label: Case is outside Anal carcinoma ruleset.
